overview: LostLink is a college Lost & Found web app where students report lost or found items without logging in, search and filter listings, scan QR codes, and get automatic match suggestions.
features: Report lost or found items without creating an account
Search and filter listings by category, location, and date
Unique QR code for every report with download, print, and camera scanning
Automatic Lost-Found matching with confidence scores and explanations
Private management codes to edit or withdraw your own reports
Claims with staff approval and single-use return verification codes
Protected admin dashboard for moderation, claims, and audit logs
